model_name: BTC entry classifier — ACTUAL DEPLOYED model (pre-HMM baseline)
status: This is the model confirmed live in production BEFORE any HMM regime work began. Confirmed directly from retrain_from_signals_all_signals.py and model_monitor.py source code, both of which train on `binary_target` (10-bar vertical barrier), never `binary_target_vb5`.
model_type: CatBoostClassifier (5 independently seeded fits, averaged at inference)

features.note: No HMM/regime features are part of this model. Regime probabilities were tested extensively as an addition (see analysis history) and did not clear the deployment bar — this model reflects what's actually live.

KNOWN_ISSUE_feature_basis_mismatch.summary: 4 of the 27 training features (atr_pct, ema9_dist, keltner_pos, supertrend_dist) were computed relative to `corrected_entry_price` (the next bar's open, used to fix a label lookahead bug) in this training data, but the LIVE bot (signal_generator_v3.py + video_features.py) computes these same features relative to the raw signal-candle close at inference time.
KNOWN_ISSUE_feature_basis_mismatch.confirmed: Verified empirically to match the exact magnitude of the entry-price correction itself (median ~0.28% of price level) across all affected columns.
KNOWN_ISSUE_feature_basis_mismatch.impact_tested: Retrained with the feature basis corrected to match live (raw price) and retested on both the frozen historical Test and a genuinely fresh 2026 live holdout — historical Test AUC was unchanged (0.858 -> 0.848) and fresh-forward AUC was unchanged (0.566 -> 0.557). This is a real bug worth fixing in the codebase but was directly tested and does NOT explain the historical-vs-live AUC gap on its own.
KNOWN_ISSUE_feature_basis_mismatch.recommendation: Fix atr_pct/ema9_dist/keltner_pos/supertrend_dist to use the raw signal-candle close consistently in any future retrain, even though it wasn't the primary driver of the live gap.

test.note: permanent frozen holdout, never touched during training

catboost_hyperparameters.random_seed: one of [42,43,44,45,46], fit independently per seed

inference: predict_proba averaged across the 5 seed models

results.fresh_forward_note: Evaluated on live trades from 2026-05-10 onward, never used in training. Substantially below the historical Test AUC. Extensively investigated (see analysis history / README) — staleness, labeling window, feature-computation window, train/val boundary effects, and the feature-basis bug above were all tested directly and none explain the full gap.

probability_thresholds.reverse_bucket_E: <= 0.35 -- trade the opposite of the raw signal

reproduction_verified_note: Verified to reproduce 0.8575 +/- 0.0027 exactly in a clean directory before packaging.
